text: Defining decentralization through historically formed centralized perspectives is a contradiction in terms that undermines its true potential and limits the scope and scale of decentralized approaches.

abstract: Defining decentralization through historically formed centralized perspectives is a contradiction in terms. It undermines the true potential of decentralization.
